messages:
deepa: quick design check — working on a tighter invite drawer for org settings. goal: one-click presets for common role combos + an inline SSO enforcement hint so admins don't miss it. attaching a short gif in Figma. thoughts on the audit log jump target when admin invites?
jon: looks nice. one thing: when i toggle SSO enforcement the role preview flips below and steals focus. keyboard users might lose context.
maria: agree with jon. also the SSO label "require SSO" is ambiguous — does it mean enforce on invite or enforce org-wide? can we change to 'Require SSO for this invite' or show a tooltip?
ashwin: +1 on clearer copy. accessibility nit: the tooltip is only visual; screen readers don't announce that extra line. we should add aria-describedby to the toggle.
robin: on the roles grid — if we collapse roles into a compact matrix we risk hiding the scopes. proposal: add an info affordance that expands inline and persists its state per user.
deepa: good points. suggestion: presets top-left, compact matrix center, and a small "scope" pill that reveals the permission list below each role.
jon: quick keyboard repro:
```
1. open invite drawer (i)
2. tab to presets
3. press Enter to apply
4. tab to SSO toggle -> notice focus jumps after toggle
```
looks like a focus trap in the role render layer.
maria: audit log question — when an admin clicks "view invite events" from the drawer, should we deep-link into Audit > Filters (pre-filled) or open an inline modal showing recent invite activity? inline modal keeps context, deep-link helps power users.
ashwin: from an a11y perspective modal means extra announcements; deep-link with an accessible skip link could be cleaner. also make sure the filter chips are keyboard tabbable.
robin: design tradeoff: modal = faster context, deep-link = discoverability in full audit UI. maybe do modal for first click and show "open full audit" link.
deepa: that sounds reasonable. UX question: how do we surface the SSO enforcement rationale? legal wants a short sentence: "SSO enforced: users must sign in via SSO to access org resources." maybe link to org SSO settings.
jon: microcopy suggestion: change "SSO enforcement" -> "Require SSO sign-in" and below in smaller text: "Recommended for enterprise orgs — can be changed later." add a ? tooltip with link to docs.
maria: small visual nit: contrast of the disabled role chips is low — needs to meet 4.5:1. Also color alone shouldn't convey state; add an icon or text label.
ux-bot: accessibility checklist reminder: ensure role grid has role names as headings, toggles have aria-checked, provide focus-visible styles, and audit deep-links include query param `invited_by`.
adeep: (typo, meant deepa) noted — i'll iterate and post a new artboard. i'll also add the aria-describedby id and update copy to "Require SSO sign-in (for this invite)". i'll prototype the modal-first, deep-link-second pattern and include keyboard walkthrough.
ashwin: thanks — can you also include a test plan item for screen readers and keyboard-only flows? i can pair on that.
robin: one more tiny ask: when presets are applied, show a small transient toast: "Preset applied: Role X + Y" with a link "edit permissions".
deepa: will do. planning to push updated files by EOD. tagging @maria @jon for final quick review before i hand off to eng. :thumbsup:
